items.q: Can I change tiers during the project?
items.a: Yes. If we find at the start of the project that you need features from a higher tier, we adjust the scope and price transparently before moving forward.

items.q: What if my project doesn't fit exactly into any tier?
items.a: The tiers are references. Many projects are hybrids (e.g. Landing Essential + a booking module). We quote a specific scope based on your real needs.

items.q: What does the price NOT include?
items.a: The price does not include: your own domain, Apple/Google developer accounts for mobile apps ($25 Google one-time, $99/year Apple), professional copywriting, professional photography, or premium software licenses (Sanity Pro, Vercel Pro where applicable).
During the support period listed for each tier, we fix any development-related bug at no charge. New changes or features are quoted separately or covered under the monthly maintenance plan.

items.q: Can I upgrade to a higher tier later?
items.a: Yes. Every project is built on scalable architecture. You can start with Express and grow to Essential or beyond later, paying only the difference plus the cost of the new features.
